Status is coloured too: missing red, partial yellow, done green, deviating purple. Confidence is red below 40, yellow below 75 and green from 75. A struck-through confidence has a stale benchmark and must be rerun. A date under a confidence is the day it was last checked against the primary source; one with no date has not been checked that way.

Under each benchmark are its signatures: the compiler, the machine and the workload its number came from. Two benchmarks of one feature are compared only when the signatures both record are the same; when one differs the benchmark is unfair and says which. An unsigned benchmark records none, so it is compared with nothing.
